test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BOSS’ is coded as '21967' and 'DEAL' is coded as '19192414'. How will 'GAIN' be coded in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed is:

The first alphabet is increased by + 4 & positional value of the opposite alphabet is the code.

The second alphabet is increased by + 3 & positional value of the opposite alphabet is the code.

The third alphabet is increased by + 2 & positional value of the opposite alphabet is the code.

The fourth alphabet is increased by+ 1 & positional value of the opposite alphabet is the code.

Now,

 'BOSS’ is coded as '21967'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90c9d36816c8c68e1827516bacf799bdde752d981fdee4462774db076b8721c2.png] 

'DEAL' is coded as '19192414'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7f20d5a17efa3ae93fa165e0e6a478796236317b69159b89564bd312f857eff.png] 

Similarly, for GAIN:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c930421c74c74db9ad639f349ce01ebc81eb37f4278e4c635ff8336313656fb.png] 

**'GAIN' will be coded as '16231612'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
